author: Vinheteiro
description:
What happens when you drop dozens of glass marbles directly onto the strings of an acoustic grand piano and start playing?

In this experiment, the sound waves and mechanical vibrations of the piano strings make the marbles jump, collide, and create a completely unique percussive sound.
